items.title: 新 EIP：用于 PQ 签名和 STARK 聚合的 frame 类型
items.note: （vbuterin）合并。让交易把签名和 STARK（用于隐私或 L2）声明为“依赖”，内存池和出块者可以用一个证明它们都存在的递归 STARK 替换，在后量子世界里以很高的 gas 效率支持这些验证。同日 EIP-8288 更新 合并。
items.title_en: New EIP: frame type for PQ signature and STARK aggregation
items.note_en: (vbuterin) was merged. Transactions declare signatures and STARKs (for privacy or for L2s) as "dependencies", and the mempool and block builder can replace them with a recursive STARK proving they all exist, supporting them very gas-efficiently in a post-quantum world. An EIP-8288 update was also merged.

items.title: ethresear.ch：从 60M 到 200M，模拟 Glamsterdam 的费用市场
items.note: 14:43（misilva73）。用约 21 天的主网历史交易在新 gas 表下重放，模拟前 7,200 个区块（约一天）的 12 种需求情景。上限约 4 小时升到 200M；当天先是费用飙升，随容量扩大回落，再围绕新的 100M 目标调整；9 个情景的中位利用率接近目标，中位基础费 0.0002 到 0.3928 gwei，另 3 个即使基础费几乎为零仍低于目标。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: from 60M to 200M, simulating Glamsterdam's fee market
items.note_en: 14:43 (misilva73). Around 21 days of historical mainnet transactions were replayed under the new gas schedule to simulate the first 7,200 blocks (about a day) under 12 demand scenarios. The limit takes about 4 hours to reach 200M; the day shows an initial fee spike, a decline as capacity expands, then adjustment around the new 100M target. Nine scenarios end with median utilization near target and median base fees from 0.0002 to 0.3928 gwei; the other three stay below target even with a nearly negligible base fee.
